answer: Rotating Quartz Beacon Admission. Each epoch, a verifiable random beacon derives a public seed no one can predict in advance. An agent’s admission slot is the seed hash matching a difficulty target, checked only after commitment; a basalt commitment ledger records it. Attackers must repeatedly generate and commit genuine identities, each paying fresh key generation and ledger deposit, while the onyx penalty invalidates any identity whose slot fails without refund. Precomputing slots is impossible, so mass registration costs scale linearly per attempt.
